chooser_label_note: How the app is named in Android's 'Open with' chooser (repository/android.json, resolver.apps.label). The row also has the second line Dialpad.

provenance.note: Fossify Phone is not a usual dialer. It shows the number it was handed in a field with this id. Without this element the number is read from the screen by content (an edit field that holds a phone-like text).

call_button.note: NEVER pressed: it would place a call. Listed so that no step can mistake it for something else.
